manage.title: Update your website
manage.intro: Edit shared images, links, dates and company details once under English + Shared Settings. Edit Khmer page wording under Khmer Text Only.
manage.signText: Sign in to Pages CMS with GitHub and choose the website repository.
manage.changeText: Company Settings keeps English and Khmer company names, descriptions, addresses, hours, footer and SEO together. Shared photos, URLs, dates, publishing controls and common contact details appear only once.
manage.reviewText: Wait for your host to finish building. Check / and /kh for the updated content.
manage.note: The editor requires a connected GitHub repository and Pages CMS access. This page itself is a public guide, not a login or a content editor.
manage.enHint: Choose English + Shared Settings for English text and all shared photos, URLs, dates, publishing controls and company settings.
manage.khHint: Choose Khmer Text Only for Khmer page text, product translations, news translations and image descriptions.
